sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Varma,J.
1.
Heard counsel for the applicant and Sri V.P. Tripathi, learned AGA for the State.

2. The instant bail application, under Section 439 Cr.P.C., has been filed with a prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 46 of 2024, under Sections 147, 148, 323, 386, 342, 376, 354,
504 and 506/34 I.P.C., Police Station- Kareli, District- Prayagraj, during pendency of the trial.
3. Counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the instant case due to certain other dispute between the parties.

The first information report was lodged against the applicant and three others on 26.03.2024, under Sections 147, 148, 323, 386, 342, 354, 504, 506 Jamaluddin Alias Jamal Topi vs State Of U.P. on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/116125630/
1 I.P.C., Police Station Kareli, District- Prayagraj.

sentences.text: In the statement of the victim under Section 161 Cr.P.C., there is no allegation of rape against the applicant.
However, in the statement of the victim under Section 164 Cr.P.C., specific allegation of indecent behaviour has been alleged against the co-accused, Ranvijay.
The case of the applicant is clearly distinguishable form that of the co-accused, Ranvijay.
The applicant has not been nominated as the offender who acted indecently with the victim.
The applicant is in jail since 10.07.2024, having no criminal history.
In case he is enlarged on bail, he will not misuse the said liberty.
4. Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer for bail but could not satisfactorily dispute the aforesaid facts from the record.

5. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and having perused the record this Court prima facie finds that there are major inconsistencies in the F.I.R., statement of the victim under Section 161 Cr.P.C. on the one hand and under Section 164 Cr.P.C. on the other.
The applicant has not been nominated as the offender who acted indecently with the victim.

Further, the applicant has no criminal antecedents and has remained confined for more than one month and after submission of the charge-sheet there is no hope of early conclusion of trial, more so when no reasonable apprehension has been brought to the fore by the State that the applicant, if enlarged on bail, would either tamper with the evidence or delay the trial or intimidate the witness, without commenting on merits of the case, I am of the opinion that the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.

6. Let the applicant, Jamaluddin Alias Jamal Topi involved in the aforesaid case be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned on the following conditions that:
i. the applicant shall not temper with the prosecution evidence; ii. the applicant shall not pressurize the prosecution witness; and, iii. the applicant shall appear on each and every date fixed by the trial court.
7.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.

Order Date :- 14.8.2024 Sachin Mishra  Jamaluddin Alias Jamal Topi vs State Of U.P. on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/116125630/
